name: MSA
description: Master Services Agreement. Umbrella contract between a Client and a Supplier governing all future engagements: agreement reference, effective date, initial term, expiry date, governing law, client jurisdiction, number of Statements of Work, total contract value, auto-renewal, payment terms and late interest, limitation of liability cap, indemnity, insurance, confidentiality, termination notice, non-solicitation, SLA credits, data protection and dispute resolution.

name: SOW
description: Statement of Work. Project-specific document issued under and governed by a parent Master Services Agreement (refers to the MSA reference and date). Contains SOW reference, parent agreement, service description, start and end date, duration, commercial model (fixed price or time and materials), SOW value, team size in FTE, scope of services, deliverables and milestones with target dates and percentage of value, charges and payment schedule.

name: NDA
description: Non-Disclosure Agreement. Standalone confidentiality agreement between parties: definition of confidential information, obligations of the receiving party, permitted disclosures, exclusions, term of confidentiality, return or destruction of information, remedies and governing law. No services, deliverables or pricing.

name: EC
description: Employment Contract. Agreement between an employer and an individual employee: job title, date of joining, probation period, salary and benefits, working hours, leave, notice period, termination of employment, non-compete, and employee confidentiality obligations.
